'''Elżbieta Kossecka''' (born 13 December 1940) is a Polish [[physicist]]. She is a professor of technical sciences and a researcher at the Institute of Fundamental Technological Research, [[Polish Academy of Sciences]].

==Education and career==
A graduate of the [[University of Warsaw]], she graduated from the Faculty of Mathematics and Physics in 1962, obtaining a [[master's degree]] in theoretical physics. After a one-year internship at the Institute of Theoretical Physics, the University of Warsaw, she worked for two years as an assistant at the Department of Mathematical Methods of Physics. In 1965, she started working at the Institute of Fundamental Technological Research, [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] (IFTR PAS), where she worked successively as a senior assistant, assistant professor, associate professor and professor.<ref name= goldtech>{{cite book |editor1-last= Pikoń |editor1-first= Krzysztof|editor2-last= Sokołowska|editor2-first= Agnieszka|editor3-last= Pikoń|editor3-first= Krystyna|date= 2003|title=Złota księga nauk technicznych |language= pl |trans-title= Golden Book of Technical Sciences|publisher= Helion S.A. |page = 190|isbn= 83-7361-188-6}}</ref> In 1969 she obtained the [[Doctorate|doctoral degree]] (thesis topic: Theory of dislocation lines in a continuous medium).<ref name= IFTR>{{cite web| url =https://www.ippt.pan.pl/en/staff/ElżbietaKossecka|title= IFTR PAS staff – prof. Elżbieta Kossecka |access-date=2019-05-13}}</ref> In 1974 she obtained the [[Doctor of Science|postdoctoral degree]] (subject: Mathematical theory of defects).<ref name= IFTR/> In 1994 she received the title of professor.<ref name= IFTR/><ref name= profile>{{Cite web |url =http://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=54581&_k=yt26k2|title= Polish Science Database - Elżbieta Kossecka |access-date= 2019-05-15}}</ref>
Head of the Laboratory of Defect Theory at IFTR PAS in the years 1978–1979, head of the Laboratory of Building Thermal Control (1988–1996), deputy director of the Helio-Ecostructures Center (1992–1997), head of the Laboratory of Structures and Environment Modeling (1996–2007),<ref name= anniversary>{{cite web |url= http://www.ippt.pan.pl/historia/50-lecie-ippt.html?start=7 |title= 50-lecie IPPT |language= pl |trans-title= 50th anniversary of the IFTR |access-date= 2019-05-15 |archive-date= 2018-04-13 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20180413124815/http://www.ippt.pan.pl/historia/50-lecie-ippt.html?start=7 |url-status= dead }}</ref> head of the Department of Eco-Building Engineering (2007–2010).<ref name= researchgate>{{Cite web|url= https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Elisabeth_Kossecka|title= Research Gate – Elisabeth Kossecka |access-date= 2019-05-13}}</ref> In 2019 (since 2011) professor emeritus of IFTR PAS.<ref name= IFTR/><ref name= profile/>

==Research contributions==
The subject of the research work of Elżbieta Kossecka in the IFTR PAS in the years 1965–1985 included problems of [[solid mechanics]] related to [[fracture mechanics]], falling within the scope of the theory of discrete defects,<ref name= IFTR/><ref>{{cite journal|last1= Kossecka |first1= E. |year= 1974 |title= Mathematical theory of defects. Part I – Statics |url= https://www.ippt.pan.pl/Repository/o5821.pdf |journal= Archives of Mechanics |volume= 26 |issue= 6 |pages= 995–1010|issn= 0373-2029}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|last1= Kossecka |first1= E. |year= 1975 |title= Mathematical theory of defects. Part II – Dynamics |url= https://www.ippt.pan.pl/Repository/o6098.pdf |journal= Archives of Mechanics |volume= 27 |issue= 1 |pages= 79–92 |issn= 0373-2029}}</ref> such as [[dislocation]]s, [[disclination]]s and cracks.<ref>{{cite journal|last1= Kossecka |first1= E. |last2= deWit |first2= R. |year= 1977 |title= Disclination kinematics |url= https://www.ippt.pan.pl/Repository/o6097.pdf |journal= Archives of Mechanics |volume= 29 |issue= 5 |pages= 633–651 |issn= 0373-2029}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|last1= Kossecka |first1= E. |last2= deWit |first2= R. |year= 1977 |title= Disclination dynamics |url= https://www.ippt.pan.pl/Repository/o5820.pdf |journal= Archives of Mechanics |volume= 29 |issue= 6 |pages= 749–767 |issn= 0373-2029}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|last1= Alshits |first1= V. I. |last2= Indenbom |first2= V. L. |last3= Kossecka |first3= E. |year= 1975 |title= Disclination Field in Elastic Anisotropic Media |journal= Physica Status Solidi B |volume= 70 |issue= 1 |pages= K25–K28 |doi= 10.1002/pssb.2220700150|bibcode= 1975PSSBR..70...25A }}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last1= Kossecka |first1= E. |year= 1982|chapter= The Circular Crack as a Surface Defect |editor1-last= Sih |editor1-first= G.C. |editor2-last= Zorski |editor2-first= H. |title= Defects and Fracture |url= https://archive.org/details/defectsfracturep1980lint |url-access= limited |location= Dordrecht |publisher= Springer |pages= [https://archive.org/details/defectsfracturep1980lint/page/n104 101]–107 |doi= 10.1007/978-94-011-7520-3_10 |isbn= 978-94-011-7522-7 }}</ref> In later years, however, in terms of its impact on energy consumption for heating and air conditioning of buildings and the possibility of using energy from [[renewable resource]]s.<ref name= profile/><ref name= researchgate/><ref>{{Citation|editor1-last= Gawin |editor1-first= D. |editor2-last= Kossecka |editor2-first= E. |title= Typowy rok meteorologiczny do symulacji procesów wymiany ciepła i masy w budynkach |language=pl |trans-title= Typical Meteorological Year for Simulation of Heat and Mass Transfer in Buildings |year= 2002 |publisher= Łódź: PŁ |isbn= 8388499033}}</ref> A co-author of many of In 1991 she was awarded the Gold [[Cross of Merit (Poland)|Cross of Merit]].<ref name= goldtech/>

==Personal life==
In 1965 she married Józef Kossecki. They had five children: Anna, Maria, Stefan, Paweł, and Jadwiga.<ref name= marqwhoswho/>
